landing.heroSubtitle: Stop juggling 4 different tools. FormForge replaces your form builder, waitlist manager, NPS survey tool, and help desk — all for a fraction of the cost.
landing.freeForever: Free forever for small teams. No credit card required.
landing.onePlatformSubtitle: Each mode transforms FormForge into a specialized tool — with its own public pages, dashboards, and analytics.
landing.modeFormsDesc: Drag-and-drop form builder with conditional logic and real-time submissions.
landing.modeWaitlistsDesc: Viral waitlist pages with referral tracking, leaderboards, and invite management.
landing.modeFeedbackDesc: NPS surveys with sentiment analysis, trend charts, and detractor alerts.
landing.modeSupportDesc: Ticket system with SLA tracking, canned responses, tags, and customer portal.
landing.replaceToolsSubtitle: See what you're paying for separate tools — and what you'd pay with FormForge.
landing.everythingYouNeed: Everything you need, nothing you don't
landing.everythingSubtitle: Built for teams who want powerful tools without the bloat.
landing.featureRealtimeDesc: Live data with Supabase Realtime — no polling, no refresh.
landing.featureSecureDesc: Row-level security, workspace isolation, and encrypted auth.
landing.featureAnalyticsDesc: NPS trends, referral leaderboards, SLA dashboards — out of the box.
landing.featurePublicPagesDesc: Shareable forms, surveys, and waitlists with custom branding.
landing.featureDragDropDesc: Visual form editor with 10+ field types and live preview.
landing.featureTeamDesc: Invite your team with owner, editor, and viewer roles.
landing.readySubtitle: Join {{count}}+ teams who replaced their patchwork of tools with FormForge. Start free — no credit card needed.

pricing.startFreeUpgrade: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready. All plans include a 14-day trial.
pricing.tierGrowthDesc: For growing teams that need more.
pricing.faqChangePlansAnswer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade anytime. When upgrading, you'll be charged the prorated difference. When downgrading, the new rate applies at the next billing cycle.
pricing.faqSubmissionLimit: What happens if I hit my submission limit?
pricing.faqSubmissionLimitAnswer: You'll receive a notification at 80% and 100% usage. Once you hit the limit, new submissions are queued until the next billing cycle — no data is lost. You can upgrade anytime to unlock more.
pricing.faqFreeTrialAnswer: Yes! Pro and Growth plans include a 14-day free trial with full access. No credit card required to start.
pricing.faqCancelAnswer: You can cancel anytime from your workspace settings. Your data is retained for 30 days after cancellation, and you can export everything before then.

integrations.zapierDesc: Connect FormForge to 5,000+ apps with Zapier automations.
integrations.zapierExplanation: Zapier uses FormForge webhooks under the hood. Enable this integration, then set up a Zap in Zapier using the webhook URL.
integrations.zapierstep1: Go to Zapier and create a new Zap.
integrations.zapierstep2: Choose "Webhooks by Zapier" as the trigger and select "Catch Hook".
integrations.zapierstep3: Paste the webhook URL above as the catch hook URL.
integrations.zapierstep4: Add any action app (Google Sheets, Slack, email, etc.) and publish your Zap.
integrations.convertkitDesc: ConvertKit integration is coming in a future update. You can currently use Zapier to connect FormForge with ConvertKit.
